"Mobile landscape-only top-down firefighter rescue game Mr. Rescue: Extinguish Protocol. Pixel art (red helmet, yellow suit). MUST run in landscape and fill the full phone screen. No portrait mode. No black screen in landscape. Force landscape orientation and full-screen canvas.

Dual virtual joysticks that appear on touch: left side = movement, right side = aim + fire. Always-visible clean bottom button to switch Water / Foam / Cryo / CO2. Show current type + Ready/Cooldown. All controls must be large, clear, and easy to use on mobile. Touch only.

Hold right joystick to spray. Cooldown (10-15s) starts only when released. Correct extinguisher destroys matching enemies with clear visual effect. Wrong type does little.

Enemy looks: Water = bright orange/yellow flames, Foam = dark oily/magma, Cryo = pale blue frostfire, CO2 = purple/green gas.

Rescue civilians only when close. Throw/drop only near windows or main door. Heat rises near fire. Fire spreads. Score on rescues. Multiple rooms. Update score and rescue count on success.

Collisions: player, enemies, and civilians stop at walls and furniture. Player flashes red and takes damage on enemy or fire contact. Has health. Zero health = Crew Down. Sprite stays upright (no weird tilt).

Synergies, heat risk/reward, civilian variety, room objectives, power-ups, living fire, style grade, light rogue-lite upgrades.

Enemy patrols: circular guards, doorway blockers, sweepers, figure-8, leash, and chase when carrying a civilian.

Temporary messages disappear after 2-3 seconds. UI shows heat, extinguisher status, health, score, civilians remaining, and grade. End of floor needs most civilians rescued. No debug overlays.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable mobile landscape firefighter rescue game, **Mr. Rescue: Extinguish Protocol**, in the existing project.

## Requirements
- Landscape-only, full-screen game; no portrait gameplay or black landscape screen.
- Pixel-art top-down firefighter with red helmet and yellow suit.
- Touch controls: movement joystick, aim-and-hold-to-spray joystick, and always-visible Water/Foam/Cryo/CO₂ selector with Ready/Cooldown status.
- Matching extinguisher types defeat distinct enemy types; wrong types are less effective. Cooldown starts on release.
- Rescue civilians at close range and evacuate them at a designated exit; track score, rescues, heat, health, remaining civilians, and style grade.
- Multiple rooms, fire spread, collisions with walls/furniture, player damage/flashing, Crew Down at zero health, patrol behaviors, temporary messages, upgrades, power-ups, and room objectives.
- No debug overlays. Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them at completion.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks (viewport at most 1280px wide); read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a standalone HTML canvas game in `index.html`, with no external dependencies.
- Used a fixed 1280×720 game world scaled to the viewport, plus a portrait rotate-to-landscape overlay and best-effort `screen.orientation.lock('landscape')`.
- Added keyboard controls as a desktop testing fallback alongside the requested touch controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the game UI, canvas-rendered pixel-art rooms, player, civilians, fires, enemies, and touch controls in `index.html`.
- Added extinguisher matching, spraying, release cooldowns, heat, spreading fire, collisions, patrol patterns, civilian pickup/evacuation, score, health, floor completion, upgrades, and power-ups.
- Extracted the inline script and verified syntax with `node --check /tmp/opencode/game.js`.
- Started a local server and opened the game in Playwright at `http://localhost:3002`; deployed the crew in a 1280×720 viewport. The only browser console error was a missing `/favicon.ico` (404).

### Active
- Finish browser validation and inspect a screenshot of the running game.
- Address any gameplay/UI issues found during validation.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Capture the current 1280×720 game screen as a small JPEG and inspect it.
2. Test the main gameplay flow and check browser console for runtime errors.
3. Fix any issues, then summarize assumptions and validation results.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: the full game implementation.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- The browser is currently at the local game after clicking “DEPLOY CREW”; no screenshot has yet been captured.
- `node --check /tmp/opencode/game.js` succeeded; the temporary file was extracted from the current `index.html`.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable mobile landscape firefighter rescue game, **Mr. Rescue: Extinguish Protocol**, in the existing project.

## Requirements
- Landscape-only, full-screen game; no portrait gameplay or black landscape screen.
- Pixel-art top-down firefighter with red helmet and yellow suit.
- Large touch controls: movement joystick, aim-and-hold-to-spray joystick, and always-visible Water/Foam/Cryo/CO₂ selector with Ready/Cooldown status.
- Matching extinguisher types defeat distinct enemy types; wrong types are less effective. Cooldown starts on release.
- Rescue civilians at close range and evacuate them at a designated exit; track score, rescues, heat, health, remaining civilians, and style grade.
- Multiple rooms, fire spread, collisions with walls/furniture, player damage/flashing, Crew Down at zero health, patrol behaviors, temporary messages, upgrades, power-ups, and room objectives.
- No debug overlays. Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them at completion.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks (viewport at most 1280px wide); read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented as standalone HTML canvas game in `index.html`, with no external dependencies.
- Fixed 1280×720 world scaled to viewport, portrait rotate-to-landscape overlay, best-effort `screen.orientation.lock('landscape')`, and keyboard controls for desktop testing.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented the game UI, pixel-art scene, touch and keyboard controls, extinguisher matching/cooldowns, fire spread, collisions, patrols, civilian rescue/evacuation, score, health, floors, upgrades, and power-ups.
- Standardized evacuation objective and completion checks using `requiredEvac()`; threshold is a strict majority (`Math.floor(totalCiv/2)+1`).
- Added an inline data favicon to eliminate the browser’s `/favicon.ico` 404.
- Extracted inline JavaScript and passed `node --check`; `git diff --check` passed.
- Browser-tested deployment and movement/spray input at 1280×720; verified cooldown status and observed no console errors or warnings.
- Saved and inspected latest gameplay screenshot at `screenshots/current.jpg`.

### Active

1. Briefly summarize the implementation, assumptions, and validation results to the user.

- `index.html`: complete game implementation.
- `screenshots/current.jpg`: latest 1280×720 gameplay screenshot.

## Important Context

content.text:
Implemented **Mr. Rescue: Extinguish Protocol** in `index.html` as a standalone, landscape-first mobile game. It includes touch and keyboard controls, four extinguisher types with cooldowns, civilians to rescue and evacuate, spreading fires, hazards, multiple floors, upgrades, power-ups, and score and style grading.

I assumed a floor is secured when a strict majority of its civilians are evacuated. The game passed JavaScript syntax and diff checks, and I tested deployment and controls in a 1280×720 browser with no console errors or warnings. The latest gameplay screenshot is `screenshots/current.jpg`.

The changes are uncommitted.
